entities.summary: Ardanuç is a town in Artvin Province in Turkey's Black Sea region of Turkey, 32 km east of Artvin. The name Ardanuç derives from Lazuri language and Armenian. It is the seat of Ardanuç District. Its population is 5,470 (2021).
